items.note: Even in a bad scenario — beats a bank deposit
Most likely path per Property Monitor data

items.q: Where do the numbers come from?
items.a: Property Monitor 2024 (quarterly reports), Bayut.com (public listings), Dubai Land Department (official transactions). Not 'promised yield' from developers.

items.q: Why is ROI higher than in Europe?
items.a: 0% income tax in the UAE vs 25–45% in Europe, gross yield 6–9% vs 2–4% in London/Berlin, market growth +7–10%/year post-COVID.
Global recession (pessimistic scenario is built in), geopolitics, regulatory changes. We discuss these in the personal calculation.

items.q: Can I get a calc on a specific property?
items.a: Yes. An expert runs the numbers on a real property with actual rental rates and service charges. Free, 1–2 business days.

items.q: What matters more: yield or growth?
items.a: Cashflow — yield. Accumulation — growth. Over 10 years, growth drives 60–70% of total ROI, rent 30–40%.
Annualized equivalent return. ROI +135% over 10 years = CAGR ~8.9%/year. Useful for comparing with bank deposits.
